resources.string: On the computer open the dashboard, Phone page, and make a one-time code. Then type the address and the code here.
Compare this fingerprint with the one next to the pairing code on the computer (dashboard, Phone page). Pair only if they match.
The computer did not answer. Same Wi-Fi? Is the phone link on?
The computer refused the code (wrong, used or expired).
Too many tries. Wait a minute.
Connected. JARVES is running on the computer.
JARVES is not running on the computer.
Computer offline: it does not answer.
This phone was unpaired on the computer. Pair again.
The computer needs a newer app (API %1$d).
Clock difference with the computer: %1$d s
Type the address as host:port, for example 192.168.1.20:8766 (no http, no path).
The computer\'s certificate changed. This may be a new certificate on your computer, or someone in between. Pair again only after you compare the fingerprint.
Unpairing here only forgets the pairing on this phone. Also remove this phone on the computer (Phone page) so its key stops working.
Tell me when approvals are waiting
Off by default. About every 15 minutes this phone asks your computer how many approvals are waiting and shows only the number, never what they are. Turning it off or unpairing stops the check.
1 approval is waiting on your computer
%1$d approvals are waiting on your computer
The microphone could not be opened. Allow the microphone for this app in the phone settings.
Nothing was heard. Hold the button, speak, then let go.
JARVES is still answering the last request. Try again in a moment.
Too many voice requests. Wait a little and try again.
Voice needs the secure link and the voice system running on your computer.
This phone is not allowed to use voice. Allow it on the computer (Phone page).
The microphone is open only while you hold the button and this screen is open. Nothing is recorded to a file; the sound goes only to your own computer.
This phone could not store the pairing safely, so nothing was saved. Try pairing again; if it keeps failing, check the phone lock screen is set.
Nothing is waiting for your answer.
This phone may not see approvals. Allow it on the computer (Phone page).
This phone was unpaired on the computer. Pair again.
Could not read the approvals. Try Refresh.
Phone approvals are off on the computer. Here you can only deny.
This one must be answered on the computer. Here you can only deny.
Not done: phone approvals are off on the computer.
Not done: this one must be answered on the computer.
Too many answers. Wait a little and try again.
Not done: the computer does not allow this phone to answer.
Not done: this phone was unpaired on the computer.
The computer did not answer. Your answer may not have arrived.
Check the text. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
Close and go back to the status
JARVES is busy with another request. Try again in a moment.
Too many messages. Wait a little and try again.
The computer does not allow this phone to send text.
This phone was unpaired on the computer. Pair again.
The computer did not answer. The text may not have arrived.
